incidents.title: Curve stETH/ETH Pool TVL Drop — 32% decline in 24h
incidents.description: Significant TVL outflow detected in Curve stETH/ETH pool following a large whale withdrawal. Pool balance dropped from $1.2B to $816M within 24 hours, triggering concentration monitoring alerts.
actions_taken: Curation team notified and began monitoring (T+3h)
Root cause identified as single whale withdrawal, not systemic (T+4h)
Reduced allocation from $25M to $18M as precautionary measure (T+6h)
TVL stabilized at $850M over next 48 hours
incidents.resolution: Whale withdrawal confirmed as portfolio rebalancing by institutional fund. No systemic risk. Allocation restored to $20M after 7-day observation period.

incidents.title: Pendle stETH PT APY Spike — 3.2x expected yield
incidents.description: Pendle stETH PT APY surged from 8.2% to 26.3% within 6 hours. Investigation revealed temporary supply-demand imbalance in fixed-rate market due to large maturity rollover.
actions_taken: Confirmed as temporary market effect from maturity rollover (T+4h)
No allocation change required — underlying mechanics sound
incidents.resolution: APY normalized to 9.1% within 48 hours as new PT tokens were minted. No risk materialized.

incidents.title: Suspected Oracle Delay — Spark Protocol ETH price feed stale for 45 minutes
incidents.description: Chainlink price feed for ETH/USD on Spark Protocol showed stale data (45-minute delay) during period of high market volatility. Potential for mispriced liquidations detected.
actions_taken: P1 alert triggered immediately upon detection (T+0)
Emergency call with curation team lead initiated (T+15m)
Withdrawal of 50% allocation ($5M) initiated as precaution (T+30m)
Chainlink team contacted for root cause analysis (T+45m)
Confirmed as infrastructure issue, not manipulation (T+2h)
incidents.resolution: Chainlink confirmed temporary infrastructure degradation during network congestion. No exploits occurred. Full allocation restored after Chainlink published incident report.
